console: YOU HAVE SLEPT 3 YEARS 4 MONTHS 22 DAYS

notes:
FC-01 OPERATOR OVERRIDE corpus, program 1 of 8 (Weekday, BASIC).
ADAPTATION / DOCUMENTED UNSUPPORTED-FEATURE CHANGES (the required removal list):
(1) console INPUT (BASIC lines 140/250) REPLACED by the fixed declared dates TODAY
3/24/1979 and TARGET 7/16/1969 - the v1 corpus is pure-PUT and console-GET echo
framing is UNMEASURED (README section 7, emulator audit);
(2) DEF FNA/FNB inlined as x/(y/4)*4 and x-(x/7)*7 routes - built-ins are refused
(BUILTIN-00 measures the LENGTH refusal);
(3) READ/DATA month table replaced by literal assignments t(1)=0..t(12)=5;
(4) TAB() banner/retire positioning and zone-formatted headers/dash rules DROPPED
(no counted PUT EDIT / column PUT - EDIT-00 measures the counted-SKIP refusal);
labels are carried inline on each data line instead;
(5) GOTO/GOSUB structure re-expressed as IF/DO flag ladders (goto is supported;
the port is clearer without it);
(6) the 30-day-month / 365-year calendar convention and ALL original arithmetic
quirks (dead `if b = 0 then b = 6` branch, the K-borrow RELAXED residual printed
as k5,k6,k7 rather than a recomputed decomposition of a8-summed leftovers) are
KEPT as the original's DECLARED behaviour, not corrected;
(7) SUBSTITUTION (recorded): the tense encoding (Y1*12+M1)*31+D1 vs (Y*12+M)*31+D
reaches 736305 and OVERFLOWS the 2-byte FIXED BINARY(15) cell, so the program uses
the equivalent lexicographic sign test on (Y,M,D); equivalence holds for valid
dates (|D1-D| < 31 and 31*|M1-M| + |D1-D| < 372) and the reference ASSERTS both
tests agree for the fixed inputs;
(8) INT(F*A8) with fractional F (.35/.17/.23 - fractional literals refused, see
DEC-01) becomes the EXACT integer identity (a8/100)*f + (((a8-(a8/100)*100)*f)/100)
on f = 35/17/23, which keeps every product inside bin(15) (max 1295); the
reference asserts floor(a8*f/100) equals it.
(9) REV2 SUBSTITUTION (recorded after lane-B corp1 refusal, 2026-11-02): ordered compares against a constant <= 0 are UNSUPPORTED by my compiler (measured verbatim refusal "codegen: compare > k<=0 form unproven [TBD]" on `if y3 > 0' — codegen.ml:8037: the plain scalar `> 0' bias ladder was never probed on DR); each such test became the equivalent SHIFT test on a new temp t2 declared fixed bin(15): x < 0 -> x+N < N (N=30 for day borrows, 12 for months, 500 for the i5 year-exit guard, ranges verified non-negative and <= 32767), and y3 > 0 (y3 = y mod 100, range 0..99) -> y3+1 > 1. Behaviour is identical for ALL in-range values; the expected console stream is UNCHANGED (no re-derivation needed). DR-acceptance of `> 0'/`< 0' is not claimed — that shape is UNMEASURED on the oracle (my-gap: refused by MY compiler only).
All division operands are NON-NEGATIVE (BASIC INT = floor = FIXED truncate there);
divisors are literals 100/4/7/365/30/2 on the measured n/k and x-(x/k)*k shapes.
Framing [C352]: first output statement is put skip list -> leading ""; final
statement is a non-bare PUT SKIP LIST -> exit closes the line once, NO trailing "".
The 79-col wrap stays avoided: widest derived line is 54 raw content columns, the
widest possible rendered numeric line (PLAYED/STUDIED + three 10-col fields) is 73.
The pre-1582 refusal, HAPPY BIRTHDAY, IS/WILL BE and WORKED/PLAYED branches are
compile-only under the fixed inputs (derived stream follows the executed path).
Weekday port independently cross-checked against Python datetime for 10 dates
including both century-leap branches (1900-01-01 MONDAY, 2000-02-29 TUESDAY);
derived, never captured (L3).
(10) REV3 SUBSTITUTION (recorded after lane-B corp2 ASSERT mismatch, 2026-11-02): a CONSTANT DIVISOR outside -128..127 is SILENTLY MISCOMPILED by my compiler (my-gap, NO refusal): `x / <const>" lowers to MVI A,lowbyte; PUSH H; MOV L,A; ADD A; SBB A; MOV H,A; POP D; CALL ?ID22N - a sign-extension idiom correct only when the low byte is <= 127. Measured in the linked WKDAY00.COM (corp2 evidence): all three `k1 / 365 sites emit MVI A,109 (0x6D, 365 mod 256) while every <=127 divisor (2/4/7/30/100) emits correctly; 1237/109=11, 601/109=5, 813/109=7 reproduce the wrong SLEEP/EAT/PLAY lines byte for byte. Rev3 replaces each `k1 / 365 with `t2 = k1 / 5; i5 = t2 / 73 (365 = 5*73; floor(floor(k/5)/73) = floor(k/365) for k >= 0, and k1 = INT(f*a8/100) >= 0 in every executed block). Expected console stream UNCHANGED. DR behavior for /365 is UNMEASURED - no claim; the gap is mine.
